title: Selection of a paired scan component
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols, let $G$ be a family of local update rules indexed by a Boolean, and let $u,u'$ be Boolean words whose lengths are both $W_Nm$ for some natural number $m$. For either Boolean $b$, the component of the paired scan corresponding to $b$ equals the fold of the update rule $G(b)$ over the paired decoded length-$W_N$ blocks, starting from the initial scan state.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols
$G$ assigns a local update rule to each Boolean
There is a natural number $m$ with $|u|=W_Nm$
There is a natural number $m$ with $|u'|=W_Nm$
